references.text: Basic regulations for the grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, which is the basis for the quantities mentioned in Num 28:20.
Describes the grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil as a daily offering, the same type required in Num 28:20.
Specifies the exact amounts of fine flour for the grain offering for the bull, ram, and lamb, consistent with the regulations in Num 28:20.
Parallel text about the grain offering on the Sabbath with fine flour mixed with oil.
Nearly identical text describing the grain offering amounts (three-tenths for the bull, two-tenths for the ram) at the New Moon festival.
The same regulations regarding grain offering amounts are repeated for the offering on the first day of the seventh month.
Identical amounts of fine flour mixed with oil for the Day of Atonement.
Describes the grain offering of fine flour as part of the daily offering, which forms the basis for festival offerings.
Ezekiel's vision of the future temple includes a grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil.
